title: pleopeltis ceratophylla
intro: Pleopeltis ceratophylla, commonly known as the resurrection fern, is a type of epiphytic fern native to the southeastern United States. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in the treatment of various conditions such as arthritis and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Pleopeltis ceratophylla are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and hepatoprotective properties. Further research is needed to fully explore the potential benefits and applications of this plant, but it has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential therapeutic actions.
